headline: Samsung AMS verification posting seeks converter and LDO modeling experience
fact: Samsung posted Bengaluru AMS Verification Engineer role R119757. Under Roles and Responsibilities, the advertisement seeks behavioral-modeling experience for switching converters and LDOs using SV, Verilog, Verilog-AMS or Verilog-A, real-model creation and validation, verification planning and environment development, PSL/SV assertions, scripting and automation. Prior power-management IP and SoC verification is desirable. This describes requested experience for a hiring role, not completed modeling or verification results; the posting does not name UVM.

sources.title: Samsung Careers: AMS Verification Engineer
sources.summary: The official Workday job data retains startDate August 20, 2026. Its Roles and Responsibilities list the named modeling and assertion experience and desirable prior power-management IP/SoC verification. UVM is not present; the requirements do not establish completed deployment.
